name: scene_edit
title: Edit FX scene source
description: Applies a literal string replacement to the current scene source. Requires expected_revision plus expected_sha256 from scene_read. old_string must match exactly once unless replace_all:true. Replacement bytes are literal, including JavaScript backslashes and dollar signs. Conflicts preserve source and return the current revision for rereading. Successful edits update the same open FX Studio view; scene_preview renders the result. JavaScript source changes do not mutate production defaults or an admitted Export.

changed.description: False when the edited source, name and settings matched the saved scene, so no revision was written.

validation.description: Source validation state: syntax is checked when the scene is written; runtime is not checked.

project_id.description: Project public ID the scene was edited through; absent for an account-level edit.

blockers.description: Typed blockers; empty when the call succeeded.
